all_pending = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, status='pending', page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not batch:
        break
    all_pending.extend(batch)
    page += 1

# Filter for roommates and current month (June 2023)
roommate_emails = {'an-harrison@gmail.com', 'anita.burch@gmail.com', 'nicholas.weber@gmail.com'}
current_month = 6
current_year = 2023

to_approve = []
for req in all_pending:
    sender_email = req['sender']['email']
    created = req['created_at']  # e.g., "2023-06-24T06:43:29"
    # parse date
    from datetime import datetime
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(created)
    if sender_email in roommate_emails and dt.year == current_year and dt.month == current_month:
        to_approve.append(req['payment_request_id'])

print("Requests to approve:", to_approve)
